sections.title: Portfolio
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,status,phase,due_on from v_portfolio order by code

sections.title: Evidence to review
sections.sql: select code,overdue_actions,benefits_waiting,controls_at_risk,approved_phases from v_portfolio order by code

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by code,finding

sections.title: Separate currencies and hard or soft benefits
sections.note: Proposals are not realised savings. Only current independent reviews are marked verified.
sections.sql: select currency,kind,review,sum(amount_cents)::bigint as amount_cents from v_benefits group by currency,kind,review order by currency,kind,review

sections.title: Measures
sections.sql: select code,name,unit,baseline,target,latest_value,result from v_metrics order by code,name

sections.title: Control checks
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,last_result,finding from v_controls order by due_on
